508 Red Oak Drive
Copperas Cove, TX 76522
$239,999, 5 bed, 3.50 bath, 3,039 SF, MLS# 590587

Find contentment in this welcoming residence! This intriguing home offers fireplace. 5 bedrooms, 3 and 1/2 baths. Rooms will never get stuffy thanks to the highly efficient ceiling fans. From snacks to supper, you are well-served by the eat-in kitchen with double ovens, pantry, center island. Exercise and fun come hand-in-hand here with your own inground pool. Also deserving of attention are these included features: ceramic tile flooring, wood flooring, walk-in closet and master bath.

3 full bath, 1 half bath
